progressTracker.title: Fluency
progressTracker.insight: Maintains long, natural conversation on familiar and complex real-life topics, with growing comfort in reflective and personal discussion.

progressTracker.title: Listening
progressTracker.insight: Follows teacher prompts, reformulations, and vocabulary modeling well, even during dense or improvised conversation.

progressTracker.title: Vocabulary
progressTracker.insight: Expanded into pets, home décor, antiques, negotiation language, self-management, and reflective life vocabulary.

progressTracker.title: Grammar
progressTracker.insight: New evidence shows need to consolidate present perfect vs simple past, habits vs events, and more natural sentence framing in spontaneous speech.

progressTracker.title: Analytical Discussion
progressTracker.insight: Continues connecting personal, professional, and social realities with thoughtful commentary and strong engagement.

attendanceOverview.title: Italy trip storytelling and BBC current events
attendanceOverview.summary: Rafael shared his recent trip to Italy with clear chronological storytelling and strong communicative instinct. The lesson also introduced a BBC report about Iran, strengthening listening comprehension, memory recall and real-world retelling.

attendanceOverview.title: Advanced fluency, geopolitics and international relations
attendanceOverview.summary: The class focused on advanced conversation fluency, narrative skills and geopolitical vocabulary. Rafael showed strong curiosity about global events and strong potential for advanced fluency development.

attendanceOverview.title: Lifestyle, technology and political institutions
attendanceOverview.summary: The lesson moved from health, nutrition and technology into public institutions and political developments in Rio. Rafael communicated with confidence in familiar real-life topics while grammar precision became the next growth target.

attendanceOverview.title: Dream storytelling plus AI in business and society
attendanceOverview.summary: Rafael handled spontaneous speaking, listening and interpretation around AI and business with strong analytical thinking. The key priority was improving verb accuracy and core sentence patterns without losing communicative power.

attendanceOverview.title: Structured storytelling, emotions and family language dynamics
attendanceOverview.summary: This lesson developed guided speaking with scaffolding, emotional vocabulary and clarity in past forms. Rafael showed noticeable improvement in self-correction and stronger narrative organization when supported by structure.

attendanceOverview.title: Homes, cooking processes and complex political explanation
attendanceOverview.summary: The class combined house and kitchen vocabulary with discussion of a complex political scenario at Alerj. Rafael explained a difficult real-world topic with very few gaps and showed stronger consolidation of the past simple.

attendanceOverview.title: Third Conditional and Political Discussion
attendanceOverview.summary: Rafael demonstrated strong fluency and confidence when discussing highly complex political and social issues. The main development area remains grammatical precision with advanced hypothetical structures.

attendanceOverview.title: Education, Family and Career Challenges
attendanceOverview.summary: Rafael showed progress in narrating personal events clearly and in using professional vocabulary related to law and public administration. Focus on past simple for personal narratives.

attendanceOverview.title: Pets, Home and Lifestyle Differences
attendanceOverview.summary: Rafael showed strong willingness to speak and excellent conversational stamina. His fluency is increasingly supported by descriptive ability, curiosity, and readiness to engage with authentic topics.

attendanceOverview.title: Reflective Speaking and Life Responsibility
attendanceOverview.summary: Rafael performed very strongly because the topic matched his deepest communicative strengths: reflective, meaningful, real-life discussion. Expressed values, memory, and family identity with sincerity.

goals.title: Increase structural precision without losing fluency
goals.description: Keep the current communicative confidence while improving sentence control, clearer connectors and more refined vocabulary choices.

goals.title: Consolidate past tense consistency in storytelling
goals.description: Strengthen past simple accuracy, reduce overuse of continuous forms and keep self-correction active in real speaking situations.

goals.title: Expand active vocabulary in high-value topics
goals.description: Use cumulative vocabulary from travel, geopolitics, business, emotions and daily life more naturally during live classes.

grammarOverview.title: Grammar Overview (Cumulative)
grammarOverview.summary: Rafael sustains conversation very well, but his next level of development depends on improving precision in grammar and lexical choice during spontaneous speech. The main priorities are tense selection, object placement, and clearer sentence framing.
focusPoints: Sentence structure & completion: Building connected sentences without interruption
Natural phrasing & comparatives: Avoiding literal translations
Passive voice (reporting): Using for formal news-style communication
Say vs Tell: Correct structure usage
Present perfect vs simple past: Distinguishing unfinished present-relevant situations
Habits vs current/finished actions: Separating clearly in spontaneous speech

teacherFeedback.title: Monthly teacher feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Rafael continues to demonstrate strong communicative ability and confidence. In July, he engaged naturally in conversations about pets, family responsibility, and life transitions, showing that his English remains functional even in abstract or emotionally demanding topics.

teacherFeedback.title: Current growth priority
